utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, are we still on for the repair drive this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yep, I’m still in — I heard a few folks are bringing tools and supplies, so it should be a good turnout.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, I’ll bring a few extra gloves and tape then. Do you want me to check in with anyone else about what’s still needed?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Noah — I can lend a few tools for the repair drive. Just let me know what you need.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Gus. I’ll grab what I can and let you know if I need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Noah — just swing by if you need a hand or any extra tools.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard it’s coming along nicely, and folks have already started dropping things off. If you need the details, I can go ask around and tell you what I find.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Tess. If you find out where and when drop-offs are happening, please let me know—I want to make sure I can get there without any hassle.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing, Pia—I’ll ask around and bring you the where and when as soon as I hear it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Could you head over to the community center and check the donation table? I’m keeping track of where everything is going.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing—I’ll head over there and check the donation table now. I’ll let you know what’s on it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, the repair drive? I’m telling everyone I can—it’s a great chance to pitch in. You should definitely come by if you’re free!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I might stop by if I can. Thank you for organizing it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Of course—hope you can make it! If you do, just swing by and I’ll introduce you to everyone.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Leo — I’m putting the repair drive details together now and I’ll keep it simple for everyone. What’s the first thing you want to tackle?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Let’s start with what needs fixing most urgently, then we can list tools and volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That makes sense — the top priorities are the broken fence by the playground, the leaking community hall sink, and the loose sidewalk step near Maple Street. After that, I’ll match each job with the tools and volunteers we’ll need.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Just to be sure, what part of the repair drive do you want me to help with?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can jump in late and help with whatever’s still left—sorting supplies or doing the last run of deliveries works for me.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Dane. I’ll check what’s left and let you know whether it’s supplies or deliveries.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sure, I can coordinate around the school schedule. What time is the repair drive planned for?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m thinking we should aim for Saturday morning, maybe around 9 to 11, so folks can come by after drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday morning sounds good to me, especially around school drop-off. I can help make sure the timing works for parents.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, is that the repair drive happening soon? I’ve been hearing bits and pieces—what should I know?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yeah, it’s coming up soon—people are bringing in things like lamps, small appliances, and bikes that need a little fixing. If you’ve got something, I can tell you the time and place!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds great—what’s the time and place? I might have a lamp that’s been acting up.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, right—the repair drive. What do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, are you saying you can help with the repair drive? If so, could you bring whatever tools you have handy.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yes, I can help. I’ll bring whatever tools I have handy.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, I heard about the repair drive. Want me to help spread the word a bit?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, that’d be great, thanks! I’m trying to get the word out, but I keep losing track of who I’ve told.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure — I can mention it to a few neighbors I know. Just let me know any details you want me to pass along.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll pass it along and remind folks about the repair drive. We should keep it on people’s radar.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Vik — I’ll make a note and keep an eye on what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely, I’ll keep reminding folks and let you know if I hear anything useful.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I heard the repair drive is picking up a bit—people seem willing to help if we keep spreading the word.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That’s good to hear. I can mention it to a few folks I know and help spread the word too.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’d be great, thanks. Every extra mention really helps us get the word out.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’d be glad to help, just remind me what still needs doing and when you need it by.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Oren — we still need a few small repairs sorted, and I was hoping to have everything wrapped up by the weekend.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Got it — I can help with that. What are the few repairs, and is there a particular one you want me to tackle first?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m a bit behind; what changed?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Not much changed—just bring any small tools or spare parts you can spare. If you can’t make it, no worries.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it, I can bring a few spare parts. Thanks for the heads-up!

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure, I can lend a hand with tools for the repair drive. Just let me know what you need.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Gus. I’ll make a short list and drop it by tomorrow so we can keep it simple.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Eli—just bring the list by tomorrow and we’ll go from there.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m ready to help however I can with the repair drive—just let me know what needs doing first.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Mara—that’s great to hear. I’ll start spreading the word right away, and I’ll let you know the first tasks as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sounds good, Quinn—thanks for coordinating. I’ll be here and ready when you send the first tasks.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely—I'm happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great—could you keep an eye on the donation table by the community center entrance?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Of course—I’ll keep an eye on the donation table by the entrance.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I can help keep the repair drive organized and moving. What’s the first thing you want me to line up?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great—first, could you line up a quick list of needed tools and spare parts? Then we can see what we already have and what’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll put together a quick tools-and-parts list and compare it against what we already have.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting a good turnout—people have been talking about it around the block. If you know what they still need, I’d be glad to pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Do they still need tools or just cash donations?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m not sure yet, but I can ask around and let you know. I’ll pass along whatever I hear.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I can help out—just point me to the repair drive details and I’ll do my best.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Bo — I’ll send over the repair drive details and the school pickup times so we can fit it in.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, send them over when you can and I’ll take a quick look.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, I can help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you’re really available for the repair drive, right? I’d like to know what task you can take on.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, I’m available. I can help with setup or collecting supplies—whichever you need most.
